title: Radicial reduced generic fibre
statement: Let $Z,S$ be affine schemes, $Z$ reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] and $S$ integral [def-pc-integral-scheme]. Let $g:Z\to S$ be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and let $\eta$ be a generic point of $S$. Suppose $Z_\eta$ is geometrically irreducible [def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. There are an integral affine scheme $S'$ and a universal homeomorphism $q:S'\to S$ [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism]. The unique lift $\eta'$ of $\eta$ is generic, and the generic fibre over $\eta'$ of the canonical reduction $(Z\times_S S')_{\mathrm{red}}\to S'$ is geometrically reduced. Here the reduction is the closed subscheme cut out by the nilradical [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction], and the morphism is its inclusion followed by the pullback projection [def-pc-fibre-product].

source.place: Tag 0559, second proof, and Tags 030R and 030U

proof.text: Write S=Spec A and Z=Spec B. Flatness injects B into its localization B_K over the fraction field K of A. This localization is reduced and geometrically irreducible, hence a nonzero domain. Its fraction field L is finitely generated over K.

Use FieldExtension.exists_finitePurelyInseparable_separablyGenerated to construct a commuting square of finite purely inseparable field extensions with separably generated upper field. As in Tag 030R, replace the upper field by the compositum; its reduced tensor description is a subfield and remains separably generated, since it is finitely generated and separable. Stacks Algebra Lemma 10.45.3 gives a finite purely inseparable K′/K such that (L tensor_K K′)_red is a separably generated field. Choose generators b with b^q=a/d in K, where a,d lie in A and d is nonzero. Replacing b by d*b makes its qth power a*d^(q-1) lie in A. The A-subalgebra A′ generated by these elements is a finite domain with fraction field K′. All generators have purely inseparable power equations, so Spec A′ to Spec A is surjective, integral and universally injective, hence a universal homeomorphism. In characteristic zero take A′=A.

The reduced generic pullback has ring (B tensor_A K′)_red, since localization commutes with reduction. It embeds in (L tensor_K K′)_red: tensoring the generic injection with K′ preserves injectivity, and reducing an injection preserves injectivity because nilpotence is detected in a subring. A separably generated field is geometrically reduced; every field extension of K′ preserves the subalgebra injection. Thus the reduced generic pullback is geometrically reduced. The universal homeomorphism lifts the generic point to a generic point.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_radicial_reduced_flat_generic_fibre
    {Z S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Z] [IsReduced Z] [IsAffine S] [IsIntegral S]
    (g : Z ⟶ S) [Flat g] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g]
    (η : S) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    (hgeom : GeometricallyIrreducible (g.fiberToSpecResidueField η)) :
    ∃ (S' : Scheme.{u}) (q : S' ⟶ S),
      IsAffine S' ∧ IsIntegral S' ∧ IsUniversalHomeomorphism q ∧
      ∃ η' : S', IsGenericPoint η' Set.univ ∧ q η' = η ∧
        GeometricallyReduced
          (((pullback g q).nilradical.subschemeι ≫ pullback.snd g q).fiberToSpecResidueField
            η')
